title: Dreamteam, which uses AI agents for CRM tasks like data capture and research, raised $53M across seed and Series A led by Together Fund and Accel, respectively (Jagmeet Singh/TechCrunch)
summary: Jagmeet Singh / TechCrunch: Dreamteam, which uses AI agents for CRM tasks like data capture and research, raised $53M across seed and Series A led by Together Fund and Accel, respectively — Dreamteam, a startup founded by former Freshworks executives, has raised $53 million to challenge Salesforce and HubSpot with its AI-native CRM …
